headline: Possible action on policies covering school suspensions, cyberbullying, recruitment, school attendance areas, and naloxone use.
summary: The meeting covers four older policies and five new items. Topics include public participation, meeting conduct, school attendance areas, suspension and expulsion, cyberbullying, recruitment, medical reimbursement, and opioid overdose prevention.
items: Policy 1120 Public Participation at Board of Education Meetings
Revision: Policy 5114 - Suspension and Expulsion/Due Process
Revision: Policy 3231 - Medical Reimbursement for Special Education Students
Review: Policy 5141.213 - Opioid Overdose Prevention (Emergency Administration of Naloxone)
location: BOE Auditorium and via Zoom Meeting Platform, 129 Church Street, Bristol, CT 06010
